title: Agora Workbench: Unified Workflow State Graph, Cross-Server Synthetic Bridge Edges & Router Skill Disambiguation
summary: StateGraph unifies tool state_requires/state_produces contracts, domain Enum state definitions, STATE_AFFORDANCES phrases, and SKILL.md frontmatter state tokens into a workflow planner. RouterServer validates configured BridgeEdge objects against upstream catalogs, injects synthetic bridge:{from}->{to} transitions for BFS path discovery (_find_path), and requires explicit upstream disambiguation when two upstream servers register skills with colliding names.

references.description: StateGraph initialization indexing tool transitions, domain states.py Enums, affordances, and SKILL.md state metadata
StateGraph.inject_bridges inserting synthetic bridge ToolInfo nodes and _infer_states_from_tools vocabulary inference
BFS shortest tool-transition pathfinder (_find_path) between state tokens
BridgeEdge and RouterConfig schemas binding cross-server navigation links
RouterServer._register_unified_load_skill tracking cross-upstream duplicate skill names
